title: SSE loop-stream event frame
description: Discriminated union of the framed events on a loop stream (GET /loops/{id}/events). Each frame is `{ event, data }` discriminated by the SSE `event:` name; `data` is the concrete payload for that event. Event names and payloads MIRROR events.yaml's `loop` channel (connected, stage_changed, activity, done) — the same shapes on the in-process binding. Loop signals are nudges: clients refetch GET /loops/{id}/live on each. The optional `id` mirrors the SSE `id:` transport cursor (see sse-frame.json); it is not part of any `data`.

stage_changed.title: stage_changed frame
stage_changed.description: A stage advanced or changed status.

activity.title: activity frame
activity.description: Progress within the current stage — a nudge to refetch /live.

done.title: done frame
done.description: Terminal event — the loop reached a stop state (completed/blocked/failed/cancelled).
